# SatoshisGrid

> Real-time 3D visualization of the Bitcoin blockchain, inspired by TRON: Legacy. Live transactions, blocks, whale alerts, mempool load, fee rates, halving countdown and difficulty adjustment, all drawn from public mempool.space data. A project of Dreier Labs (Steve Dreier). Not investment advice.

## Core pages

- [SatoshisGrid](https://satoshisgrid.com/): the live visualization (single page, runs in the browser with WebGL)

## Source and legal

- [Source code (GitHub)](https://github.com/maxim91136/satoshisgrid): README with feature list and tech stack, MIT license
